selection_history.reason: Gate 1 (endpoint-compliance validation of the qualifier-rewrite codec) failed against the real pinned OpenDNP3 production master: TypedCommandHeader::ApplySelectResponse silently declines to select any point when the response header carries more indexed objects (2) than the master's own request header held (1). Not an ASIC limit; the real master correctly refuses a wire construction that doesn't match what it sent. Evidence: defense4/timing/framework/size/case4_qualifier_rewrite.py, defense4/timing/framework/size/endpoint_gate/context_evidence_qualifier_01/.

Pre-committed fallback, triggered by Option A's gate-1 failure. Built as case4_pad58.py (G41V2/qualifier-0x27 filler), tested byte-exact, then FAILED endpoint-gate validation against the real pinned OpenDNP3 master/outstation -- more severely than Option A. Qualifier 0x27 is not one of the library's seven implemented qualifier codes (QualifierCode.cpp: 0x00,0x01,0x06,0x07,0x08,0x17,0x28); it decodes to QualifierCode::UNDEFINED, and APDUParser's two-pass design aborts the WHOLE fragment parse on any unrecognized qualifier, discarding the real native data (all 23 READ points; the SELECT/OPERATE echo) along with the filler, not just rejecting the filler itself. Evidence: defense4/timing/framework/size/case4_pad58.py, defense4/timing/framework/size/endpoint_gate/TestCase4Pad58.cpp, emit_vectors_pad58.py.

Filler restricted to the library's seven whitelisted qualifier codes, built as case4_pad58b.py. CONTROL (19B gap): one G41V3 (32-bit float Analog Output Block) object, qualifier 0x28, 2 points (5B header + 2x7B = 19B) -- the only whitelisted single-object fit with real point data. READ (9B gap): three ALL_OBJECTS (qualifier 0x06) headers, G41V1/V2/V3, 3B each, no count field, no point data (3+3+3=9B) -- the arithmetic-only count=0 design this document originally proposed is WRONG (NumParser::ParseCount rejects COUNT_OF_ZERO, aborting the whole fragment exactly like 0x27 did; caught only empirically). Also found: 0x07/0x08 are whitelisted in general but CountParser only recognizes Group50/51/52 for them, so G41Vx/G12V1 fillers under 0x07/0x08 fail too -- unusable for this filler at all. Empirically CLEARED against the real pinned OpenDNP3 master/outstation, confirmed twice (dispatching agent + independent re-run same session, fresh output dir): 62/62 assertions pass; CONTROL gets a real OPERATE and genuine SBO actuation (physicalActuations=1); READ delivers all 23 real points (points_received_after_padded=23); clean recovery on both roles afterward. Strictly better than A (silent decline) or B (total data loss).

pattern.description: Single uniform 58-byte padded TCP payload for READ, SELECT, OPERATE responses; no split.
pattern.mechanism: whitelisted-qualifier filler append (case4_pad58b.py), empirically cleared against the real pinned OpenDNP3 master/outstation; P4 data-plane realization not yet started

READ.transform_required: append a 9-byte filler (three ALL_OBJECTS/qualifier-0x06 headers, G41V1/V2/V3, no point data) to reach 58B

SELECT.transform_required: append a 19-byte filler (one G41V3/qualifier-0x28 object, 2 points) to reach 58B

OPERATE.status: software_codec_cleared_endpoint_gate (exercised directly in TestCase4Pad58B.cpp's OPERATE round trip, not just inferred from SELECT); P4 realization not started
